intro: Basketball has become South Sudan's greatest sporting success.

chapters.title: Basketball
text: The Bright Stars qualified for the 2023 Basketball World Cup and the 2024 Olympics, where they beat Puerto Rico. Luol Deng, born in Wau, helped build the programme.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Football and wrestling are also popular.
